project.name: SmartTwinRes Skills
project.description: 智慧水利水库运行管理矩阵平台 (Smart Water Reservoir Operation Management Platform) — A Claude Code Skill collection for reservoir management covering six domain skills (forecasting, plan-generation, simulation, early-warning, diagnosis-verification) plus a supervisor orchestration layer that routes, plans, and arbitrates multi-skill DAG workflows.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the SmartTwinRes-skills shared lib; re-exports tenant/db/filters/paths submodules.

nodes.name: bootstrap.py
nodes.summary: Three-tier locator for the project root (SRM_SKILLS_ROOT env, candidate roots, RuntimeError fallback). Provides locate_root/locate_lib/locate_shared.

nodes.name: MAX_ROWS
nodes.summary: Global hard row cap, env-configurable via SRM_DB_MAX_ROWS (defaults to 1000).

nodes.name: LARGE_TABLES
nodes.summary: Per-table large-table metadata (time column + min_rows threshold) forcing callers to add time-range predicates.

nodes.name: AUTORESEARCH_DIR
nodes.summary: Root path for autoresearch outputs across skills.

nodes.name: DEFAULT_RESERVOIR_NAME
nodes.summary: Fallback reservoir profile name ('sancha') used when SRM_RESERVOIR_NAME is unset.

nodes.name: locate_root
nodes.summary: Resolve the repository root directory by checking SRM_SKILLS_ROOT then known candidates; raises RuntimeError if not found.

nodes.name: locate_lib
nodes.summary: Return the absolute path of the lib/ directory via locate_root().

nodes.name: locate_shared
nodes.summary: Return the absolute path of the shared/ cross-skill knowledge base directory.

nodes.name: require_env
nodes.summary: Public alias of _require_env: read a required env var or sys.exit with a fail-loud message (prevents hard-coded credentials).

nodes.name: get_connection
nodes.summary: Acquire a MySQL connection from the PooledDB pool, falling back to a single pymysql.connect() if dbutils is unavailable.

nodes.name: execute_query
nodes.summary: Run a SELECT and return a result dict with data/count/truncated metadata; respects MAX_ROWS cap.

nodes.name: execute_query_list
nodes.summary: Backward-compatible wrapper that returns execute_query()['data'] as a plain list[dict].

nodes.name: unpack
nodes.summary: Idempotently extract the 'data' list from an execute_query() result (or pass through a bare list).

nodes.name: query_one
nodes.summary: Run a scalar SELECT and return a single value (first row, first column).

nodes.name: execute_write
nodes.summary: Run an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with commit and rollback, returning the affected row count.

nodes.name: apply_tenant_filter
nodes.summary: Inject a tenant_id = N predicate into SQL based on the table name; rejects non-integer or negative tenant_id.

nodes.name: apply_deleted_filter
nodes.summary: Inject a deleted = 0 predicate into SQL based on the table name (no-op when the table has no deleted column).

nodes.name: apply_table_filters
nodes.summary: One-shot helper that runs apply_tenant_filter then apply_deleted_filter on the given SQL.

nodes.name: validate_table_filter
nodes.summary: Return (need_tenant, need_deleted, message) describing which filters apply to a given table.

nodes.name: generate_where_clause
nodes.summary: Build a full WHERE clause (tenant_id + deleted + extras) for a table, returning empty string if nothing applies.

nodes.name: get_skill_dir
nodes.summary: Resolve a skill directory by name (forecasting, simulation, etc.); raises ValueError on unknown skill.

nodes.name: get_reservoir_dir
nodes.summary: Return reservoirs/<name>/ path. Resolves name from arg > SRM_RESERVOIR_NAME > DEFAULT_RESERVOIR_NAME.

nodes.name: get_autoresearch_dir
nodes.summary: Resolve the per-skill autoresearch output directory; raises ValueError on unknown skill.

nodes.name: ensure_dirs
nodes.summary: Create all standard output/log/data/autoresearch directories (parents=True, exist_ok=True).

nodes.name: ensure_path
nodes.summary: Normalize and dedupe-prepend one or more paths onto sys.path to avoid long-running sys.path bloat.

nodes.name: current_tenant_id
nodes.summary: Canonical tenant-id resolver: reads SRM_TENANT_ID with one-shot stderr warning, falls back to DEFAULT_TENANT_ID.

nodes.name: current_reservoir_name
nodes.summary: Read SRM_RESERVOIR_NAME (trimmed/lowercased); return None when unset. Used to route knowledge-layer references/reservoirs/{name}/.

nodes.name: resolve_reservoir_name
nodes.summary: Resolve reservoir name with priority: explicit arg > env > DEFAULT_RESERVOIR_NAME.

nodes.name: resolve_tenant
nodes.summary: Resolve tenant_id with priority: explicit arg > current_tenant_id() (env/default).

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 水库水文预报智能解读 Skill v1.0.1（forecasting）。覆盖降雨预报解读、水库影响估算、多源预报融合、水位趋势预测、预报精度评估、预报决策。包含 12 类查询（current_water_level/rainfall_forecast/flood_limit/full_context 等）、3 段式输出蓝图、9 条预报规则（置信度/影响估算/分歧裁决）、法规依据 GB/T 22482。

nodes.name: query_forecast_data.py
nodes.summary: 预报主取数脚本（12 个 --type）。含 get_master_stcd 辅助函数、12 个查询函数（current_water_level/rainfall_forecast/weather_warning/flood_limit/model_forecast_result/zonal_rainfall_forecast/water_level_curve/historical_floods/forecast_accuracy_stats/multi_source_overview/config/full_context），主入口 query_full_context 聚合核心 5 项。tenant=18（三岔），参数化 SQL + LIMIT 1000。

nodes.name: query_forecast_analysis.py
nodes.summary: 预报场景分析脚本（4 个 --type 分析密集型）。query_fusion_detail（四源逐时对齐 + NMC fixture 解析 + 分歧标注）、query_accuracy_report（按源 MAPE + gated_flag 恒 true 因 C1 缺陷未修）、query_similar_floods（按峰值水位排序）、query_forecast_timeline（预报 vs 实测 bias/MAE）。复用 query_forecast_data.get_master_stcd。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 水库调度预案智能生成 Skill v3.2.1。覆盖防汛形势评估/汛情研判/水情分析/预案生成/方案对比/历史预案查询/调度决策。含调度目标选择（防洪优先/兴利/综合）、调度模式 0-5 映射、目标水位确定、调度时长选择、多方案生成（A防洪/B综合/C兴利）、法规依据《防洪法》第41条/GB 17621-1998/SL 224-2019。

nodes.name: query_plan_data.py
nodes.summary: 预案数据查询脚本（13 个 --type）。含 query_current_water_level、query_rainfall_forecast（f_rnfl_h 主表+子查询）、query_weather_warning、query_flood_limit（att_res_flse_lim + att_res_base 回退）、query_historical_plans、query_historical_floods、query_similar_plans（按水位接近度排序）、query_recent_rainfall、query_scenarios、query_water_level_curve、query_discharge_curve、query_config、query_full_context（M4 契约新增 max_level/max_discharge 顶层键供 supervisor 仲裁消费）。

nodes.name: query_plan_analysis.py
nodes.summary: 预案分析专用脚本（4 个 --type）。query_plan_detail（model_result_files ⟕ dispatch_history 一次 SQL 取预案+调度）、query_plan_actual_water（预案时段实测水位）、query_scheme_context（生成方案所需：当前水位/汛限/配置/历史预案）、query_similar_plans（按水位接近度）、query_full_analysis（聚合）。

nodes.name: dispatch_model.py
nodes.summary: 水库调度优化模型（Flask API，端口 18082）。DispatchModel 类：interpolate_wl_to_cap/interpolate_cap_to_wl/interpolate_wl_to_flow 线性插值、water_balance 水量平衡方程 V(t+1)=V(t)+(I-O)*dt、optimize_dispatch（约束优化调度方案）、_determine_outflow（按 scheduling_target/model 决策）。提供 /api/dispatch/optimize 与 /api/dispatch/verify 接口。含三岔默认曲线 fallback 与单调性 assert。

nodes.name: flood_routing.py
nodes.summary: 调洪演算模型（Flask API，端口 18083）。FloodRoutingModel 类：wl_to_cap/cap_to_wl/wl_to_max_outflow 线性插值、route（按水量平衡逐时段计算水位/库容/累积流量，P2-2 修复超限溢流记为 extra_outflow，P2-5 用 np.cumsum 替代 O(n²)）。提供 /api/routing/calculate 与 /api/routing/water-balance 接口。

nodes.name: xaj_model.py
nodes.summary: 新安江水文模型（XAJ，Flask API，端口 18081）。XAJModel 类：evapotranspiration 三层蒸散发、runoff_generation 蓄满产流（P2-1 修复 A 公式 + P2-17 修复 WU→WL→WD 级联充填）、source_partition 水源划分（地表/壤中/地下径流）、flow_routing 汇流计算。P2-3 用 threading.local per-request 实例保证 threaded=True 线程安全。提供 /api/xaj/forecast 与 /api/xaj/reset。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 水库预演 AI 增强 Skill v1.9.3。覆盖 6 大能力：多方案对比预演、结果智能解读、虚拟场景构建、预演报告生成、敏感性分析、历史经验提取。模型服务编排 XAJ(18081)+Dispatch(18082)+Routing(18083)+Orchestrator(18084)。三段式输出+法规依据 E2/E4 强制。HITL 检查点：方案选择/参数确认/报告发布。

nodes.name: query_simulation_data.py
nodes.summary: 模拟数据查询脚本（14 个 --type）。含 query_current_water_level、query_flood_limit、query_config、query_water_level_curve、query_discharge_curve、query_historical_floods、query_flood_detail、query_flood_result（统计 type=7）、query_flood_result_curve（type IN 1,2,3,6）、query_flood_inflow、query_flood_statistics、query_similar_floods（按降雨量容差 ±20%）、query_scenarios、query_recent_rainfall、query_full_context（M4 契约显式 max_level/max_discharge）。

nodes.name: simulation_service.py
nodes.summary: 预演编排服务（Flask API，端口 18084）。核心函数：call_model_service（带超时/连接错误处理）、check_idempotency（SHA256 缓存 5min）、run_multi_scheme（多方案对比 + _build_comparison 推荐）、run_virtual_scenario（XAJ→Dispatch→Routing 三阶段串联，partial failure 处理）、run_sensitivity（线性回归求 safety_threshold）、run_batch_run、generate_report。SANCHA_PROFILE / TAOQUPO_PROFILE 双水库常量。提供 /api/simulation/multi-scheme、virtual-scenario、sensitivity、batch-run、report 等端点。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 智慧水利预警系统 Skill v5.2。覆盖告警分析/诊断/预测/问答。核心表 ew_info_message（2021 条）+ew_info_rules（25 条）+st_rsvr_r+st_pptn_r。告警 4 级（红/橙/黄/蓝）、5 类（0水位/2雨量/5大坝/12设备离线/40视频AI）、动态等级调整（超标 10/30/60% 分档）、趋势预警（连续单调变化）。含告警处理检查清单、日报/周报/复盘模板、HITL 检查点交互。

nodes.name: query_early_warning.py
nodes.summary: 告警查询脚本（14 个 --type）。query_unconfirmed/query_by_level/query_recent/query_by_station/query_high_level（输出含 level_r 字段对齐 arbitrate_emergency 期望）、query_rules/query_station_ranking/query_hourly_distribution/query_device_offline/query_alarm_trend/query_rule_detail/query_water_level/query_rainfall/query_alarm_storm/query_confirmation_rate/query_weather_warning。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 水库四预系统诊断与验证 Skill v1.0。8 阶段结构化诊断（Phase 0 澄清-Phase 8 知识沉淀）、6 层独立验证（数据源/格式/业务规则/安全约束/跨域一致性/法规符合性）、6 步自动修复流程。覆盖 forecasting/early-warning/plan-generation/simulation 全场景。6 类根因：外部系统异常/内部代码缺陷/数据问题/基础设施问题/LLM 异常/预期行为。

nodes.name: check_data_quality.py
nodes.summary: 数据质量检查脚本（4 个 --type）。check_water_level（st_rsvr_r 时效+空值率）、check_rainfall_forecast（f_rnfl_h 批次距现在小时）、check_alerts（ew_info_message 未确认+红橙堆积）、check_all（as_json=True 输出结构化对齐 arbitrate_dam_diagnosis 期望的 {age_hours, null_rate}）。_iter_problems 生成 P0/P1 问题集。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: 四预智能体 Supervisor 协同编排层 v0.4。把 forecasting/early-warning/plan-generation/simulation/diagnosis-verification 当工具按 DAG 编排。4 类场景：A 汛期暴雨研判（七步）/B 大坝诊断（五步）/C 日常管控（三步）/D 应急响应（五步）。State 持久化 SQLite（events+stage_results）。仲裁：方案 vs 仿真（HITL step5/6 之间）。

nodes.name: scene_router.py
nodes.summary: Supervisor 场景识别（路由）。SCENE_RULES 关键词表驱动（D 应急 100>A 暴雨 80>B 大坝 60>C 日常 40）。route(trigger) 返回 {scene, name, dag, reason, matched_keywords}。EMERGENCY_STRONG/DAM_STRONG/DAILY_STRONG 强信号词优先判定（P1-2 修复大坝信号不被日常词压制）。UNKNOWN 不猜测。

nodes.name: supervisor_state.py
nodes.summary: Supervisor 全局 State 持久化（SQLite，断点续跑）。表 events（event_id/scene/status/risk_level/trigger/priority/created_at/updated_at）+ stage_results（event_id+stage 复合主键）。子命令：new/queue（v0.4 优先级队列）/stats（运维观测）/replay（失败重放提示）/health（cron 数据时效）/set/get/resume/status/list。P3-8 改走 lib.paths.ensure_path。

nodes.name: orchestrator.py
nodes.summary: Supervisor DAG 编排主脚本。STAGE_CMDS 字典定义 4 场景的 stage→(agent, cmd) 映射（A 七步/B 五步/C 三步/D 五步）。run_stage_cmd（subprocess + 60s 超时 + 60000 字符截断）、load_reservoir_params/resolve_thresholds（从 model_config + att_res_flse_lim 读取汛限/安全泄量）、_extract_sim_peaks（M4 契约 max_level/max_discharge 解析）、do_arbitration（分派 B/D/A 仲裁）、do_report（汇总 State 生成 Markdown 报告）。HITL 在 step5/6 之间强制确认。

nodes.name: arbitrator.py
nodes.summary: Supervisor 结果仲裁。arbitrate_plan_vs_simulation（方案 vs 仿真水位以仿真为准/超安全泄量 reject）、arbitrate_risk_levels（取更高等级防洪优先）、arbitrate_emergency（场景 D：Ⅰ/Ⅱ级告警 escalate/超安全泄量 reject/超汛限 escalate/HITL 强制 hitl_required=True）、arbitrate_dam_diagnosis（场景 B：数据过期>24h 或空值率>50% 高/P0P1 缺陷高/超汛限高）。ArbitrationResult dataclass（passed/decision/issues/adopted_values/suggestion）。

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the unified evaluation runner.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the eval lib helpers (schema, judge, transport, truth, report).

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Unified evaluation runner CLI. Loads YAML cases, applies AND-combined filters, runs each case through a Hermes subprocess, judges the output (inline / live_db / rubric, optionally with an LLM judge), and writes JSON + Markdown reports. Exits 0 in gate mode only when every case passes.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Parse CLI flags: --list, --cases-dir, --report-dir, --truth {inline,live_db,rubric}, --skill, --subset, --tag, --id, --no-judge, --with-llm.

nodes.name: filter_cases
nodes.summary: AND-combine --skill / --subset / --tag / --id / --truth filters against the loaded EvalCase list.

nodes.name: _dispatch
nodes.summary: Route a single case to judge_inline / judge_live_db / judge_rubric based on case.truth_source.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: End-to-end runner: parse args → load cases → filter → live-DB query_fn → run each case via transport_fn → dispatch judges → write reports → return gate exit code.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: EvalCase dataclass plus loader/validator. Required fields include id/skill/category/description/question/env{source,truth_source,SRM_TENANT_ID} and truth-source-specific fields (expected_keywords/expected_range, truth_query, or rubric).

nodes.name: EvalCase
nodes.summary: Single evaluation-case dataclass carrying id, skill, category, question, env, source, truth_source, optional timeout/tags, and one of inline (expected_keywords/range/forbidden), live_db (truth_query/tolerance/expected_keywords), or rubric (rubric items).

nodes.name: _coerce_str_list
nodes.summary: Coerce a YAML value (list, str, or None) into a list[str] used for keywords/forbidden/rubric fields.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Reject malformed cases: missing core fields, bad truth_source, missing SRM_TENANT_ID, or truth-source-specific omissions.

nodes.name: _case_from_dict
nodes.summary: Construct EvalCase from a dict, merging file-level forbidden_keywords with case-level forbidden entries.

nodes.name: load_file
nodes.summary: Load a single YAML case file into a list of validated EvalCase objects.

nodes.name: load_all
nodes.summary: Load every YAML file in a directory and raise ValueError on duplicate case IDs.

nodes.name: judge.py
nodes.summary: Verdict logic for inline / live_db / rubric truth sources. Inline judging delegates to tests.reservoir_profile.verify_output; live_db delegates to eval.lib.truth.compare_with_tolerance; rubric combines rule-layer checks with an optional Anthropic LLM judge (model overridable via EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL).

nodes.name: _extract_numbers
nodes.summary: Regex-based numeric extractor over the model output (shared with truth.extract_numbers).

nodes.name: _keyword_check
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive substring OR-check of expected keywords against the output.

nodes.name: judge_inline
nodes.summary: Adapt an EvalCase into a TestCase and delegate to verify_output; returns {verdict, detail}.

nodes.name: judge_live_db
nodes.summary: Run case.truth_query via the provided query_fn, extract numeric truth, compare against output numbers with tolerance, and re-check expected_keywords.

nodes.name: judge_rubric
nodes.summary: Rule-layer check (forbidden + expected_keywords) AND-composed with an optional LLM judge; returns PASS/FAIL/SKIP for the rubric layer.

nodes.name: _build_prompt
nodes.summary: Build a strict-JSON prompt that lists every rubric criterion and instructs the LLM to return {passed, items[]}.

nodes.name: _parse_rubric_score
nodes.summary: Parse LLM JSON output into the rubric-score dict; falls back to a uniform fail on malformed JSON.

nodes.name: make_anthropic_client
nodes.summary: Lazy-import anthropic and construct an Anthropic client; returns None when the SDK is unavailable.

nodes.name: llm_judge
nodes.summary: Run an Anthropic messages.create call (model = env EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL or default 'claude-sonnet-5') and parse the strict-JSON response.

nodes.name: transport.py
nodes.summary: Run a single evaluation case as a Hermes subprocess. Merges case env over os.environ, sets cwd to the skill directory, and normalizes subprocess.TimeoutExpired into a timed_out result.

nodes.name: run_hermes
nodes.summary: Run `hermes chat -q <question> --skills <skill_id> -Q` with injected env, return {output, stderr, exit_code, timed_out}.

nodes.name: truth.py
nodes.summary: Live-database truth helpers. Reads SRM_DB_* env vars, builds a single connection-lifetime query closure, and exposes tolerance-aware numeric comparison.

nodes.name: extract_numbers
nodes.summary: Extract numeric tokens from the model's output (delegated into judge.py for keyword/inline checks).

nodes.name: compare_with_tolerance
nodes.summary: Return {truth, tolerance, extracted, passed} for `any(|n - truth| <= tolerance for n in numbers)`.

nodes.name: _connect
nodes.summary: Lazy pymysql.connect using SRM_DB_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/NAME; reads credentials exclusively from env.

nodes.name: make_db_query_fn
nodes.summary: Create one process-lifetime connection and return a closure that executes SQL with a cursor (per docs: short-lived CLI, recycle-on-restart).

nodes.name: report.py
nodes.summary: Reporting layer: build per-result dicts (truncating output to 500 chars), aggregate pass/fail by skill and category, and serialize to JSON + Chinese Markdown.

nodes.name: build_result
nodes.summary: Build a result row from (case, verdict, elapsed, output, detail) and truncate output to 500 chars.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Group results by (skill, category) and compute overall + per-skill pass rates.

nodes.name: write_json
nodes.summary: Write {summary, results} to a JSON file.

nodes.name: write_markdown
nodes.summary: Write a Chinese Markdown report with per-skill tables and per-case [x]/[ ] pass marks.

nodes.name: reservoir_profile.py
nodes.summary: Legacy reservoir-profile test fixture reused by eval inline judging. Defines TestCase and ReservoirProfile dataclasses plus verify_output (keyword + range + forbidden checks) and load_reservoir / load_all_reservoirs YAML loaders.

nodes.name: TestCase
nodes.summary: Legacy single-case dataclass: id, skill, description, question, expected_keywords, optional expected_range, with verify_output interpreting forbidden[].

nodes.name: ReservoirProfile
nodes.summary: Reservoir profile dataclass: name, tenant_id, display_name, forbidden_keywords, cases, with load_reservoir / load_all_reservoirs parsing reservoirs/<name>.yaml.

nodes.name: _extract_numbers
nodes.summary: Regex extraction of numeric tokens (int/float, negative supported).

nodes.name: verify_output
nodes.summary: Run keyword + optional range + forbidden checks against an output, returning {keywords_passed, range_passed, forbidden_hits, all_passed, ...}.

nodes.name: _coerce_keywords
nodes.summary: Coerce expected_keywords into a normalized list[str].

nodes.name: load_reservoir
nodes.summary: Load a single reservoirs/<name>.yaml file into a ReservoirProfile.

nodes.name: load_all_reservoirs
nodes.summary: Load every reservoir YAML under reservoirs/<name>/*.yaml.

nodes.name: forecasting.yaml
nodes.summary: 25 forecasting evaluation cases (F1-F25). Covers water levels, rainfall interpretation, flood limits, multi-source fusion, trends, forecast accuracy, historical floods, and extreme scenarios. Mixed inline/live_db/rubric truth sources.

nodes.name: plan-generation.yaml
nodes.summary: 25 plan-generation evaluation cases (PG1-PG25). Covers plan generation, flood-season assessment, emergency response, historical plans, boundary conditions, and invalid-parameter rejection.

nodes.name: simulation.yaml
nodes.summary: 30 simulation evaluation cases (SIM1-SIM30). Covers multi-scheme simulation, virtual scenarios, reports, sensitivity analysis, historical experience, and invalid flood IDs.

nodes.name: early-warning.yaml
nodes.summary: 33 early-warning evaluation cases (EW1-EW33). Covers alert querying, root-cause analysis, trend prediction, risk assessment, cross-domain correlation, emergency response, and missing-data conditions.

nodes.name: supervisor.yaml
nodes.summary: 10 supervisor evaluation cases (SUP1-SUP10). Covers scenes A/B/C/D, HITL pauses, priority queues, routing, and resume behavior.

nodes.name: diagnosis-verification.yaml
nodes.summary: 10 diagnosis-verification evaluation cases (DV1-DV10). Covers data staleness, alert accumulation, six-layer verification, safety-constraint blocking, root-cause analysis, and six-step remediation.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Unified evaluation runner documentation. Describes CLI usage, case schema, truth-source semantics, LLM-judge model override (EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL), AND-combined filters, and the 133-case set (25 forecasting + 25 plan + 30 sim + 33 EW + 10 supervisor + 10 DV).

nodes.name: sql-safety-rules.md
nodes.summary: Cross-skill SQL safety rules: read-only SQL in skill scripts, parameterized %s, WHERE + LIMIT required, no string concatenation, no DDL, tenant filtering required.

nodes.name: tenant-filtering-rules.md

layers.name: Shared Infrastructure
layers.description: Cross-cutting Python utilities (lib/): tenant resolution, MySQL pool + query/write helpers, table-aware tenant/deleted-filter injection, path/skill/reservoir locators, and project-root bootstrap. Imported by every skill.

layers.name: Domain Skills
layers.description: Five 四预 domain skills — forecasting, plan-generation, simulation, early-warning, diagnosis-verification — each with a SKILL.md plus parameterized SQL scripts that wrap lib/db.py + lib/tenant.py. Plan-generation and simulation additionally ship Flask model services (XAJ, flood routing, dispatch optimization, multi-scheme orchestration).

layers.name: Supervisor Orchestration
layers.description: DAG-based meta-orchestrator (supervisor/) that wires the five domain skills into four scene workflows (A 暴雨 / B 大坝 / C 日常 / D 应急). Comprises the scene router (keyword→DAG), persistent SQLite state (queue/stats/replay/health), the DAG executor (subprocess with timeouts), and the result arbitrator (plan-vs-simulation, emergency escalation, dam-diagnosis risk, risk-level max).

layers.name: Evaluation & Test Framework
layers.description: Unified Hermes-driven eval runner (eval/run.py) plus the eval/lib stack — schema loader/validator, Hermes subprocess transport, live-DB truth comparator with tolerance, inline/live_db/rubric judges (rule-layer AND-composed with an optional Anthropic LLM judge), and JSON+Markdown reporting — together with the 133 YAML eval cases and the unittest suite (test_arbitrator, test_scene_router, test_supervisor_state_ops, test_tenant_isolation, test_models, test_judge, test_eval_*, and integration tests).

layers.name: Shared Documentation & Conventions
layers.description: Cross-skill documentation and rule docs — eval/README.md (CLI usage, case schema, 133-case set, AND-combined filters, EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL override) plus shared/ rules covering SQL safety (parameterized %s, WHERE+LIMIT, no DDL, tenant filter required), tenant-filtering precedence (explicit arg > SRM_TENANT_ID > default 18), and DB-connection conventions (SRM_DB_* env, no hard-coded credentials).

tour.title: Project Overview & Shared Knowledge Base
tour.description: SmartTwinRes Skills is a Claude Code Skill collection for water reservoir management. The repo has no single entry point — it is a constellation of skills (forecasting, plan-generation, simulation, early-warning, diagnosis-verification, supervisor) coordinated through a shared library and an evaluation harness. Start here to see the cross-cutting rules every skill follows: SQL safety, tenant filtering, and database connection conventions.

tour.title: Shared Infrastructure (lib/)
tour.description: The lib/ package is the backbone every skill imports. It resolves the project root (bootstrap.py), opens pooled MySQL connections (db.py), injects mandatory tenant_id and deleted filters (filters.py), manages skill / reservoir / autoresearch output paths (paths.py), and resolves the active tenant from env (tenant.py). All skills depend on these modules; none of them talk to the DB directly.

tour.title: Flagship Domain Skill — Simulation
tour.description: Simulation is the flagship skill: it runs multi-scenario 'what-if' forecasts over a dispatch plan. Its SKILL.md declares the agent contract, scripts/query_simulation_data.py pulls current state from MySQL through lib/, and models/simulation_service.py encapsulates the comparison/sensitivity logic. This mirrors the structure every other domain skill follows (SKILL.md + scripts/ + models/).

tour.title: Companion Domain Skills
tour.description: Five domain skills sit alongside simulation. forecasting produces rainfall / water-level / flood-limit predictions; plan-generation produces 3 dispatch schemes (A/B/C) and runs hydrologic models (XAJ, flood routing); early-warning raises 4-level alarms with correlation analysis; diagnosis-verification runs an 8-phase diagnose + 6-layer verify + 6-step auto-fix pipeline. Each has the same scripts/ + models/ shape and queries the DB via lib/.

tour.title: Supervisor Orchestration Layer
tour.description: The supervisor is the brain that routes user queries to the right skill combination. scene_router.py classifies the request, orchestrator.py drives the DAG, supervisor_state.py records replay / stats / health, and arbitrator.py resolves conflicts when multiple skills produce competing answers (e.g. plan A vs. simulation says B is safer).

tour.title: Evaluation Framework
tour.description: eval/ is the unified testing harness. run.py is the CLI entry — it parses flags, filters cases, and dispatches them. lib/schema.py loads and validates YAML cases, lib/judge.py implements four judge modes (inline, live_db, rubric, llm), lib/transport.py runs Hermes, lib/truth.py compares against DB ground-truth with tolerance, and lib/report.py aggregates results into JSON and Markdown.

tour.title: Evaluation Cases per Skill
tour.description: Every domain skill ships with a YAML case file in eval/cases/ that defines scenarios, expected keywords / numbers, and judge mode. The six cases are: forecasting, plan-generation, simulation, early-warning, supervisor, and diagnosis-verification. Adding a new skill means dropping a new YAML here and the runner picks it up automatically.

tour.title: Reservoir Profiles & Test Harness
tour.description: The reservoirs/ directory (sancha, taoqupo) holds per-reservoir configuration, but the type-safe loader lives in tests/reservoir_profile.py — the ReservoirProfile class plus load_reservoir / load_all_reservoirs functions are reused by the eval judge as the ground-truth oracle. The surrounding tests/ tree covers tenant isolation, scene routing, arbitrator, models, and the full supervisor end-to-end flow.
